unsupported: Hoosier Custom Plastics handles production volumes ranging from a few thousand to several million pieces per year, manufacturing components such as caster wheels, electrical connectors, sealing systems, golf tees, food handling parts, gardening components, automotive transmission and interior parts, and appliance components for washers, dryers, and dishwashers.
